decisions.reason: As a newly launched software extension very close to the core practice-management offer, it is still an inexpensive strategic option whose market potential in a growing digital dental market is not yet resolved after only one year.

The training institute builds on the existing customer base and support capabilities, and after only one year the firm would rationally keep this complementary option open because it can strengthen lock-in and reveal demand with limited irreversible commitment.

Remote screen-sharing support fits the established service model and likely has low continuation cost, so with high strategic fit and still-uncertain upside the option value of keeping it exceeds the case for early abandonment.
